  Creatinine is a nitrogenous waste product formed in muscle from creatine phosphate. Endogenous production of creatinine is
  proportional to muscle mass and body weight.

   Causes of Increased Serum Creatinine Level                        Causes of Decreased Serum Creatinine Level
   1. Pre-renal, renal, and post-renal azotemia                      1. Pregnancy
   2. Large amount of dietary meat                                   2. Increasing age (reduction in muscle mass)
   3. Active acromegaly and gigantism
